public_payload.normalized_proposition: At some point OpenAI and Anthropic will need new money exactly when hyperscalers and lenders are cutting back.
conditions: once hyperscalers stop spending and banks pull back

statement.excerpt: This will mean, at some point, that both OpenAI and Anthropic will be walking around with their hands out saying “money please!” at precisely the moment that everybody will be cutting back.

our_interpretation: In context, the antecedent is a broad hyperscaler spending retrenchment accompanied by a pullback in data-center lending.
I read 'everybody' as the relevant spending and financing ecosystem, rather than literally every investor.
Both laboratories must seek substantial external financing during the same documented retrenchment. Routine fundraising outside that episode is insufficient.
The claim specifies neither a financing amount nor an accounting basis. Those omissions are retained rather than supplied from later reports.
criteria.support_condition: The broad spending-and-lending pullback occurs, and dated records show both laboratories seeking substantial new external funding during it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A completed pullback episode occurs, and affirmative financing and liquidity records show that at least one laboratory did not need or seek new external money throughout that episode.
